correctness.rationale: For each integer n≥2, J>0 and gamma>0, the no-jump matrix K=-iH-gamma P0/2 has no eigenvalue with zero real part, since its eigenvector at the absorbing endpoint would vanish recursively, and all spectral real parts are negative. The unique X solving K†X+XK=-I equals the displayed parity-resolved kernel, verified directly at diagonal, bulk, absorbing boundary and terminal boundary indices. Its diagonal gives the localized mean; the gamma-plus-inverse-gamma minimization and uniform-state trace are exact. The attached script ran 39 full exact rational matrix identities and 33 independently solved numerical Lyapunov systems (all passed); no claim that finite checks prove the infinite family.

value.rationale: A full closed coherent-state absorption-time operator for any finite path and positive loss strength eliminates a growing matrix inversion. Its localized-source optimal sink rate is exactly independent of chain length beyond the source, unlike the uniform-source optimum, distinguishing local quantum-Zeno optimization from global geometry. The all-size quantitative result offers a direct benchmark for quantum transport with irreversible local extraction. This structural identity is materially more informative than a two-site example or a generic inverse formula.
